items.content:
Index cards on the shelf ends, handwritten, staff picks but for a specific
mood rather than a genre — "for when you can't concentrate", "for a long
bath", "if you liked the one about the house".

Would cost roughly nothing. Would require permission from three people.

summary: Handwritten mood-based staff-pick cards on the shelf ends, needing three sign-offs
title: A reading-room recommendation card system
